messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-15T14:04:56Z - Elevated 5xx (segfault/OOM) observed for /v1/chat generate across model-runner shard group 'gpu-shard-east-1'. Error rate 12% in 5m window. Possible recent runtime change: quant-fastpath patch.
Maya: Paging on-call @Jason @Priya. I'm taking lead. Jason you good to deep-dive?
Jason: Oncall ack. grabbing pods + dmesg.
Priya: I'll quarantine the shard in the router and move traffic to warm-warm fallback set.
Leo: Ops: I'm seeing an uptick in customer retries; opening tickets for top affected tenants.
Ava: Notifying product and comms. Will coordinate status page message draft.
Jason: quick logs from a dying pod:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] model-runner pid=4121: malloc: failed to allocate zone 0x1e8 (size=1048576)
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] kernel: oom_kill_process: killing process 4121 (model-runner) score 987
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] model-runner: segfault at 0x0 in qk_fastpath+0x2a
```
Jason: Pattern: allocation failures immediately followed by segfault in qk_fastpath (quantization). Rollout history? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: quant-fastpath v3 rolled to gpu-shard-east-1 at 2026-03-15T13:30:00Z (canary 25% -> 100% at 13:55:10Z).
Priya: Routing change: marking gpu-shard-east-1 unhealthy and shifting weight to gpu-shard-west-1 and cpu-emergency. Propagation ~45s.
Maya: Good. Can we avoid a full rollback? Any runtime toggle?
Jason: There's an env toggle `QUANT_FASTPATH_ENABLE=false` but it requires pod restart. We can patch the DaemonSet for the shard and restart to avoid rolling back artifacts.
Priya: SRE will cordon nodes in shard and restart pods with toggle set. Also scaling fallback pools +3 replicas.
Ava: Drafting status: short note that "we've rerouted traffic and are investigating a runtime quantization regression causing OOMs/segfaults". Will share once approved.
Leo: Customer impact summary so far: ~8 tenants with >5% error rate; majority transient due to retries. SLA exposure minimal but noticeable.
Jason: Capturing core dumps to /artifacts/2387765432/cores/ and enabling increased log level for qk module. Running gdb: backtrace indicates crash internal to qk_apply_small_vector.
Jason: gdb bt snippet:
```
#0  0x7f9cdeab in qk_apply_small_vector (ctx=0x7fffa...) at qk_core.c:271
#1  0x7f9cddb2 in apply_kv_updates
#2  0x560a3b in run_inference
```
Priya: Patch applied to DaemonSet with `QUANT_FASTPATH_ENABLE=false`, restarting pods now.
Priya: Routing half traffic back to shard (safe-check) after restart shows 0.6% errors on that subtree.
Maya: Keep shard at 0% traffic until we validate memory stability for 15m. If stable, we can ramp to 10% canary then 50%.
Ava: Status page proposal: "Incident in us-east: elevated 5xx caused by a runtime quantization path resulting in OOM/segfaults. Traffic has been rerouted; affected nodes are being restarted with the quant path disabled. Continued monitoring. Postmortem to follow."
Maya: Approved. Leo, please post once I give the go.
Leo: Copy. prepping post.
Jason: For RCA: initial hypothesis — quant-fastpath v3 introduced an allocation path that doesn't honor cgroup memory limits under heavy batch sizes, leading to OOM then null pointer in qk path. Will reproduce with stress test.
Priya: I scanned other regions; west/eu haven't rolled v3 yet. Paused global rollout.
Ava: Communicating to customers: offering a workaround (set model concurrency limit lower) for tenants that can change it quickly. Drafting email.
Maya: Mitigation checklist: 1) isolate shard, 2) restart with toggle disabled, 3) scale fallback, 4) pause rollout, 5) collect cores & logs, 6) produce status update. All done except cores collection and deeper debug.
Jason: Uploading artifacts: /artifacts/2387765432/logs.tar.gz and /artifacts/2387765432/cores.tar.gz
Priya: Observability: error rate dropped to 0.5% globally, latency +150ms on fallback. No new OOMs in restarted pods after 12m.
Maya: I'll stay on incident for another 45m and then handoff to eng-sre with notes. Jason, continue bisect and attempt a minimal reproducer. Priya, make sure autoscaler isn't thrashing.
Ava: I'll queue a customer follow-up for top 10 impacted tenants and include point of contact.
Leo: Marking tickets updated.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused for quant-fastpath v3 at 2026-03-15T14:20:01Z by Priya.
Maya: Thanks team. We'll call this mitigated for now; keeping channel open for 1h watch. Logging incident and will produce postmortem template.
incident-bot: Incident 2387765432 severity set to MEDIUM and status MITIGATED by Maya at 2026-03-15T14:30:00Z.
